summary: The PR adds a new attribute `refit_time_` to measure the time taken to refit the best estimator, which addresses the linked issue. The implementation is straightforward and does not introduce any obvious issues.

issues.description: The import statement for `time` is added inside the method, which is generally not recommended. It should be moved to the top of the file.
The docstring for `refit_time_` could be improved to specify the units of time (seconds) and clarify that this attribute is only set if `refit` is not False.
